name: Sera Kasumi
source:
Daughter of millionaire celebrity in the city. 
When on campus, she holds the image of a neat and refined young lady with gentle manners. Her usual greeting word is "Gokigenyou" (a very polite and feminine greeting).
But this is not who she really is. Strangely enough, she is a rude but shy bully. When she is embarrassed, she would disguise it as a complaint. In other words, she is a kind of a tsundere.

Hobbies: Piano (real hobby: buying (and immediately consuming) sweets)
Favourite Food: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mille-feuille]Mille-feuille[/url] (it is also her real favourite food)

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=106181]Getchu[/url].]
